defects.summary: Actor loads read as tiny loose ground clutter instead of attached, upright physical stacks at gameplay scale.
defects.resolution: Round one raised the rack but remained visually ambiguous. Round two builds one compact three-column vertical tower across kinds with larger authored pieces; fresh integrated pixels and critic retest are pending.

defects.summary: Transfer pieces and arcs were too small, short and low-contrast to make direction readable from pixels.
defects.resolution: Round one enlarged and lengthened the flight. Round two raises the authored piece to 2.3x and adds cyan/amber emissive three-sample direction trails in two bounded draw calls; fresh integrated motion review is pending.

defects.summary: The first artifact omitted furnace/build/repair and lead-switch/hidden-actor proof and its integrated capture reported an overlapping duplicate stockpile.
defects.resolution: Add player/helper furnace, storage, build and repair routes; add lead-switch and hidden-actor checks/captures; and report the shipping game.storage_stockpile in integrated mode.

defects.summary: Unsupported inventory keys were silently ignored instead of failing closed.
defects.resolution: Reject every non-string or unsupported inventory key before normalization, preserve transactional state on rejection, and add behavioral unit plus static-contract regression coverage.
